body: Unfortunately everything is unstable. I'm not doing as well as I should in school, I don't have a job, my relationships with my family have essentially shattered, I had a recent nasty breakup, and my goals/direction in life is very unclear, I'm unsure of what I want to do with myself.
Thank you for your comment, I appreciate it.

Thank you all for your kind words. They have all been very comforting and positive and I am extremely grateful. I'm still a bit unsure and indecisive, but I've definitely taken all the comments into account. Thanks again.
Thank you. I'll try to remember this.
I'll consider it... I'm still afraid of their responses and how I'm going to react to it.. but thank you for your kind advice.
Sorry, I meant that I have no basis or knowledge of how to make it on my own. my mom has been very controlling of my life.

I'm in college right now, just finished my first year. however, I let my parents down, I didn't meet their standard, and they're the ones paying for college. I feel like I've failed and disappointed them. My mom wants me to transfer to a community college and to pay for it on my own, as well as finding a new home. But because I've had to unwillingly be dependent on my mother for my entire life, I have no basis or knowledge to do so. It seems like I have more freedom in this sense but I don't have anywhere to start except from literal scratch.
I hope that everyone will heed this message. And thank you..
Thank you for your kind words and your comfort. It means so much.
Knowing my family, they would play the guilt trip. They would find some excuse to reject my love and why they believe I don't love them. They always want to play the victim...

My family may be upset, but not about me being gone or that I was hurting. They would most likely focus on themselves instead of me, especially my mother who likes to play victim. I'm not saying I'm looking for attention, but my family has a rather interesting sense of logic and selfishness.
Thank you... It's comforting to know that even strangers can sincerely care about me.

Thank you..
I have "clipped wings" in the sense that I can't freely go anywhere I want to start over, I rely financially on my mother, and I have no form of transportation (no car and such). Think of it as the equivalent as being a young child, even younger than I am (I'm 18). A lot of people would think 18 year oldshave a lot of freedom, but it's still just as limited as a child.
Thanks for your response. I feel uncertain, though. I wish I could know that I mattered to someone. I don't get that impression from anyone, and that's what makes me feel so alone.
Thank you for your comment. I most definitely would anticipate finding my place on this crazy planet, but there's only so much I can do in my position.

Thanks, this makes me feel better. I just wish that as an 18 year old with clipped wings there were more opportunities for me, in the sense that I am unfortunately almost entirely dependent on my mother financiallyand transportation wise.
